title: docs(advisory-convergence): warn against job `name:` override breaking exact-match rerun
body:
## Background

The rerun helper and the advisory-wait policy both use the literal
check-run context `idd-advisory-convergence`. GitHub derives a
check-run name from a job's `name:` field when one is present; otherwise
the job id supplies the context name.

An adopter can therefore change the check-run context without changing
the job id: adding a display-name key to the job makes the actual
check-run name differ from the literal context consumed by the helper
and the external-check waiver path. The rerun helper then reports no
matching instances even when the workflow has run for the current HEAD.

The source workflow already warns that changing the job id requires
keeping the helper selector, policy selector, and required status check
in sync. It does not warn that adding a display-name key has the same
effect. The workflow currently has no such key, so this is a preventive
documentation gap.

The workflow comments themselves are the adopter-facing guidance: the
source copy is the dogfooded reference and the template copy is what
adopters copy. Updating both copies keeps this warning adjacent to the
job definition and avoids duplicating a warning already covered by
recent onboarding documentation work.

## Proposed change

Extend the existing job-context comment in both copies of
`idd-advisory-convergence.yml`:

1. State that the job id is the exact check-run context consumed by the
   rerun helper, advisory-wait policy, and external-check waiver
   configuration.
2. Warn adopters not to add a `name:` display-name key to this job
   unless they also update every consumer of the exact context.
3. Keep the warning next to the existing job-id synchronization note so
   it remains visible when the workflow is copied or customized.
4. Run the documentation audit after editing the mirrored files.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The source workflow comment names both job-id changes and adding a
      `name:` display-name key as changes that can break exact
      check-run matching.
- [ ] The `idd-template/` workflow carries the equivalent warning.
- [ ] Both warnings identify the literal context
      `idd-advisory-convergence` and the consumers that depend on it.
- [ ] `node scripts/audit-docs.mjs --check` passes.

## Candidate files

- `.github/workflows/idd-advisory-convergence.yml`
- `idd-template/.github/workflows/idd-advisory-convergence.yml`
